The '''horned dewback''' was a species of creature [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] from [[Mutant|mutated]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]]. They could be used as mounts.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horned dewbacks were creatures in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
